summary: Tested Website Projects redesign feature matching 'Operations Website Project' style. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all requested features: project header with name/status/Edit button/progress bar, project details info row (Domain, Developer, Platform, Type, Client, Location), Pages/Tasks tabs, enhanced pages table with per-column controls (Status dropdown, Assignee selector, Date picker, Add URL button), search functionality, and delete button in Actions column. All interactions (status change, assignee selection, date picker, URL add, Edit Project modal) work correctly and persist changes.

issues: Docs/Drive buttons only appear when URLs are set in project - this is expected behavior but could show disabled state when not configured

seed_data_creation: Used existing projects: Acacia Homess, Acme Corp Website
context_for_next_testing_agent: Website Projects redesign fully tested. Navigate to Tasks > Website > click any project to see the redesigned detail view. Features verified: 1) Project header with name, ACTIVE status badge, Edit button, progress bar (0/8 format), dates 2) Project details info row with 6 cards (Domain, Developer, Platform, Type, Client, Location) 3) Pages/Tasks tabs toggle 4) Search pages functionality 5) Add Page button and modal 6) Pages table with columns: #, PAGE NAME, WIREFRAME, UI DESIGN, CONTENT, DEVELOPMENT, OVERALL, ACTIONS 7) Each column cell has: Status dropdown (6 options), Assignee selector (shows avatar with initials), Date picker, Add URL button 8) Delete button (trash icon) in Actions column 9) Edit Project modal with all fields. Backend endpoints tested: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for /api/departments/website/projects and /api/departments/website/pages.

pages_tasks_tabs.details: Pages and Tasks tabs toggle correctly. Tasks tab shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder

search_pages.details: Search input filters pages table by page name

add_page_button_modal.details: Add Page button opens modal with Page Name, Assign To, Notes fields
